curtin-university.name: Curtin University
curtin-university.brief: Curtin University is a public research university in Bentley, Perth, Western Australia. Its main areas of study include agriculture, environment and sustainability; architecture and construction; arts and creative industries; business, innovation, management and law; education; engineering, mining and surveying; health; information technology; and physical sciences, geoscience and mathematics. Its largest campus is Curtin Perth in Bentley, and it has campuses in Kalgoorlie, Midland, Malaysia, Singapore, Dubai, Mauritius and Colombo.

imperial-college-london.name: Imperial College London
imperial-college-london.brief: Imperial College London is a public research university in London, England. Its history began with Prince Albert, who envisioned South Kensington as a cultural district with museums, colleges, and the Royal Albert Hall. Its main areas of study are engineering, medicine, natural sciences and business. The university has several campuses in London and the South East, including South Kensington, White City and Silwood Park, plus hospital campuses. Its four faculties are Engineering, Medicine, Natural Sciences and Imperial Business School.

aston-university.name: Aston University
aston-university.brief: Aston University is a public university in the city centre of Birmingham, England. It was founded as the Birmingham Municipal Technical School in 1895 and became the UK's first college of advanced technology in 1956. Main areas of study include business, engineering and physical sciences, law, medicine, pharmacy, psychology and computer science. It is organised into schools and colleges, including Aston Business School, Aston Medical School and the College of Engineering and Physical Sciences. It has study locations in Birmingham, London and online.

arizona-state-university.name: Arizona State University
arizona-state-university.brief: Arizona State University is a public research university in Tempe, Arizona, United States. Its main areas of study include business, design and the arts, engineering, health solutions, journalism, law, liberal arts and sciences, nursing, and teaching. The university has four campuses in metropolitan Phoenix, plus locations in Los Angeles, Washington, D.C., Hawai‘i, and London. Its academic units include more than 450 undergraduate degree programs and more than 400 master's degree programs.

carnegie-mellon-university.name: Carnegie Mellon University
carnegie-mellon-university.brief: Carnegie Mellon University is a private research university in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, United States. It was established in 1900 by Andrew Carnegie as the Carnegie Technical Schools. Its main areas include analytics, artificial intelligence, computer science, cybersecurity, software engineering and drama. The university is organised into schools and colleges, and it plans a new campus in Miami, CMU Miami, subject to regulatory approvals.

university-of-toronto.name: University of Toronto
university-of-toronto.brief: The University of Toronto is a public research university in the Greater Toronto Area of Ontario, Canada. It has three campuses: St. George (downtown Toronto), Mississauga (west of Toronto) and Scarborough (eastern Toronto). It was founded by royal charter in 1827 as King's College. Its academic programs are organised into faculties and divisions, including Applied Science & Engineering, Arts & Science, Medicine, Law and Management. Students at the St. George campus in Arts & Science are affiliated with one of seven colleges.

dalhousie-university.name: Dalhousie University
dalhousie-university.brief: Dalhousie University is a large public research university in Nova Scotia, Canada. It has campuses in Halifax, Truro and Bible Hill, Yarmouth, Sydney and Saint John. It offers programs across 13 faculties, including Agriculture, Architecture and Planning, Arts and Social Sciences, Computer Science, Dentistry, Engineering, Health, Law, Management, Medicine, Science, and Open Learning and Career Development.

concordia-university.name: Concordia University
concordia-university.brief: Concordia University is a public English-language research university in Montreal, Quebec, Canada. It was formed by the merger of Loyola College and Sir George Williams University, and it was founded in 1974. Its main areas of study include Arts and Science, Fine Arts, Engineering and Computer Science, Business, Graduate Studies and Health. The university has two campuses in Montreal, the Sir George Williams Campus and the Loyola Campus.

rheinisch-westfalische-technische-hochsc.name: Rheinisch-Westfälische Technische Hochschule Aachen
rheinisch-westfalische-technische-hochsc.brief: RWTH Aachen University (Rheinisch-Westfälische Technische Hochschule) is a public research university in Aachen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany. It is a technical university, and its website lists Architecture, Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering and Information Technology, Computer Science, Medicine, and Business and Economics among its areas. The university has ten faculties, numbered Faculty 1 to Faculty 10, and a Research Campus and Campus Melaten and Campus West. Its website also lists Mathematics and Natural Sciences, Arts and Humanities, and Georesources and Materials Engineering as faculties.

karlsruhe-institute-of-technology.name: Karlsruhe Institute of Technology
karlsruhe-institute-of-technology.brief: Karlsruhe Institute of Technology (KIT) is a German public research university in Karlsruhe, Baden-Württemberg, and a research center of the Helmholtz Association. Its main areas include Elementary and Astroparticle Physics, Energy, Health, Information, Climate and Environment, Materials, Mathematics, Humans and Technology, and Mobility. KIT has three campuses: North, South and East.

faculties.name: Civil Engineering, Geo- and Environmental Sciences

sorbonne-university.name: Sorbonne University
sorbonne-university.brief: Sorbonne University is a public research university in Paris, France. It has three faculties: Arts and Humanities, Health Sciences, and Science and Engineering. Its Cordeliers campus is in Paris, and it has a campus in Abu Dhabi. Its research partners include international universities and companies.

institut-polytechnique-de-paris.name: Institut Polytechnique de Paris
institut-polytechnique-de-paris.brief: Institut Polytechnique de Paris is a public technological university located in Palaiseau, France. It brings together six engineering grandes écoles: École polytechnique, ENSTA Paris, ENSAE Paris, École nationale des ponts et chaussées, Télécom Paris and Télécom SudParis. Its main areas include engineering, research in 14 research areas, and innovation and entrepreneurship. Its campus includes ecosystem, infrastructure, student life, libraries and a health center.

delft-university-of-technology.name: Delft University of Technology
delft-university-of-technology.brief: Delft University of Technology is a public technical university in Delft, the Netherlands. It specialises in engineering, technology, computing, design and natural sciences. The university has eight faculties, which cover almost 40 technological and scientific disciplines. Research is also carried out at research institutes such as QuTech and the TU Delft Reactor Institute.

faculties.name: Electrical Engineering, Mathematics and Computer Science

leiden-university.name: Leiden University
leiden-university.brief: Leiden University is a public research university in Leiden, Netherlands. Its areas of study include Archaeology, Governance and Global Affairs, Humanities, Law, Medicine, Science, and Social and Behavioural Sciences. The university has locations in Leiden and The Hague, and its organisation includes faculties and interfaculty institutes such as the African Studies Centre Leiden and the International Institute for Asian Studies.

trinity-college-dublin-the-university-of.name: Trinity College, Dublin
trinity-college-dublin-the-university-of.brief: Trinity College Dublin is a university in Dublin, Ireland, and the sole constituent college of the University of Dublin. It was founded in 1592 by Queen Elizabeth I through a royal charter. Its main areas of study are arranged in three faculties: Arts, Humanities and Social Sciences; Health Sciences; and Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics. Each faculty is divided into schools, and each school into disciplines.

the-university-of-auckland.name: University of Auckland
the-university-of-auckland.brief: The University of Auckland is a public research university in Auckland, New Zealand. It was established as Auckland University College under the Auckland University College Act 1882 and formally opened in 1883. Its main areas of study include Arts and Education, Business, Engineering and Design, Law, Medical and Health Sciences, and Science. It is organised into faculties and has campuses in Auckland.

national-university-of-singapore.name: National University of Singapore
national-university-of-singapore.brief: The National University of Singapore (NUS) is a national public research university in Singapore. It was officially established in 1980 through the government-directed merger of the public University of Singapore and the private Nanyang University. The university is a public institution located in Singapore. Its founding year and merger history are stated above. Prospective international students should consult the university's own pages for programmes, campuses and faculties.

universiti-malaya.name: Universiti Malaya
universiti-malaya.brief: Universiti Malaya is a public research university in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. Its faculties cover built environment, languages and linguistics, pharmacy, engineering, education, dentistry, business and economics, medicine, science, computer science and information technology, arts and social sciences, creative arts, law, and sport and exercise sciences. Its academic programmes include coursework, mixed-mode, research, and clinical tracks, offered full-time, part-time, and through Open and Distance Learning.

lund-university.name: Lund University
lund-university.brief: Lund University is a public research university in Sweden and one of Northern Europe's oldest universities. It is located in the city of Lund in the Swedish province of Scania. It is organised into faculties, including the Faculty of Humanities and Theology, the Faculty of Law, the Faculty of Social Sciences, the Faculty of Engineering (LTH) and the Faculty of Fine and Performing Arts in Malmö. It also has a campus in Helsingborg, Campus Helsingborg, where it offers education and research in close cooperation with companies and organisations.

university-of-oslo.name: University of Oslo
university-of-oslo.brief: The University of Oslo is a public research university in Oslo, Norway, and Norway's oldest university of its kind. UiO has been committed to education, research, science communication and innovation since 1811. Its areas of study include climate, environment and sustainability, democracy, and life science. It has 8 faculties, 2 museums and 1 university library, and offers 226 study programmes. It also runs the Climate House and Domus Bibliotheca, both in Oslo.
